attempts.summary: Configured a persistent ufw firewall on node1: SSH open to all, TCP/9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.56.11), TCP/9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else, default-deny incoming. Verified with live TCP tests before and after rebooting all three nodes; ufw persisted across node1's reboot with rules and enablement intact, and connectivity results (node2 allowed, node3 rejected) were unchanged post-reboot. All three nodes were individually restarted, each showed a changed boot_id proving an actual reboot, and each recovered SSH availability and (for node1) firewall/service health.
